messages:
Oliver Grant: Hey everyone — Oliver here, excited to join Redwood Inference as an SRE (he/him). I'm remote in Toronto but heading into the SF office Tues. Background: ops for distributed ML infra. Fun facts: iced kombucha > coffee, mechanical keyboards, terrible at folding fitted sheets. Quick q: anyone know where spare 27" monitors live? Also into plant swaps! :)

Mira Patel: Welcome Oliver!! :tada: We usually keep spare monitors in eng-infra storage near the east stairs. Ping #eng-infra or @devon for checkout.

Devon Ortiz: Hey Oliver — welcome aboard. There's a monitor sign-out sheet (paper) on the shelf, or you can `deskbook monitor` via the infra tools. I can bring a spare to drop at the SF desk tomorrow.

Jules Park: hi hi!! Don't forget to join #eng-sre, #devex and #random. Coffee club meets 10:30 in kitchen (:coffee:)

Casey Nguyen: plant swap?? count me in :seedling: I have a pothos baby ready to adopt.

onboard-bot: Welcome @Oliver Grant! Your onboarding checklist: 1) Complete HR forms 2) Get badge from reception 3) Setup 2FA 4) Join org chart. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/onboarding

Mira Patel: also +1 to keyboard appreciation. If you're into switches we started a thread in #random-keyboards.

Oliver Grant: Thanks all!! @Devon I'll DM for monitor logistics. @onboard-bot got it — almost done with HR form. See you in SF Tues :wave:

Devon Ortiz: nice — see you! :thumbsup:

Jules Park: welcome gifts are on their way (tiny bagel sticker & kombucha coupon) :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
